name: hypromelloses
uses: Indications Uses For the temporary relief of burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye For use as a protectant against further irritation
otcwarn: Do Not Use If this solution changes color or becomes cloudy If you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience any of the following: Eye pain Changes in vision Continued redness or irritation of the eye Condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
